features.feature_name: Video Intelligence API Streaming API AutoML Action Recognition
features.feature_summary: Allows AutoML Action Recognition using custom AutoML models on real-time video streams via the Streaming API.
features.extended_definition: Allows AutoML Action Recognition using custom AutoML models on real-time video streams via the Streaming API.

features.feature_summary: Detects faces in video content and identifies attributes such as whether glasses are being worn.
features.extended_definition: Detects faces in video content and identifies attributes such as whether glasses are being worn.

features.feature_summary: Detects people in video content and identifies person attributes and 2D facial landmarks.
features.extended_definition: Detects people in video content and identifies person attributes and 2D facial landmarks.

features.feature_summary: Face detection locates faces within a video and identifies attributes such as whether glasses are worn.
features.extended_definition: Face detection locates faces within a video and identifies attributes such as whether glasses are worn.

features.feature_summary: Person detection locates people in a video and identifies attributes and 2D landmarks.
features.extended_definition: Person detection locates people in a video and identifies attributes and 2D landmarks.

features.feature_summary: Logo recognition detects, tracks, and recognizes the presence of brands and logos in video content; Logo recognition is available as a beta capability in the Video Intelligence API for identifying logos in media.
features.extended_definition: Logo recognition detects, tracks, and recognizes the presence of brands and logos in video content; Logo recognition is available as a beta capability in the Video Intelligence API for identifying logos in media.

features.feature_summary: Celebrity recognition detects and tracks human faces in videos and matches them to a curated celebrity database.
features.extended_definition: Celebrity recognition detects and tracks human faces in videos and matches them to a curated celebrity database.

features.feature_name: Custom AutoML models for streaming video annotation
features.feature_summary: Video Intelligence API now supports using customer-owned AutoML models for label detection and object tracking on streaming video.
features.extended_definition: Video Intelligence API now supports using customer-owned AutoML models for label detection and object tracking on streaming video.

features.feature_name: Object-tracking annotation model improvements in Video Intelligence API v1
features.feature_summary: Video Intelligence API v1 now includes improved annotation models for object tracking.
features.extended_definition: Video Intelligence API v1 now includes improved annotation models for object tracking.

features.feature_name: Text detection annotation model improvements in Video Intelligence API v1
features.feature_summary: Video Intelligence API v1 now includes improved annotation models for text detection.
features.extended_definition: Video Intelligence API v1 now includes improved annotation models for text detection.

features.feature_name: Video Intelligence API Label Detection model version specification
features.feature_summary: The API now allows callers to choose the Label Detection model by setting LabelDetectionConfig.model to builtin/stable or builtin/latest.
features.extended_definition: The API now allows callers to choose the Label Detection model by setting LabelDetectionConfig.model to builtin/stable or builtin/latest.

features.feature_name: Video Intelligence API Shot Change Detection model version specification
features.feature_summary: The API now allows callers to choose the Shot Change Detection model by setting ShotChangeDetectionConfig.model to builtin/stable or builtin/latest.
features.extended_definition: The API now allows callers to choose the Shot Change Detection model by setting ShotChangeDetectionConfig.model to builtin/stable or builtin/latest.

features.feature_summary: Video Intelligence API provides live streaming video annotation capabilities as a beta feature.
features.extended_definition: Video Intelligence API provides live streaming video annotation capabilities as a beta feature.

features.feature_summary: Video Intelligence API provides support for streaming input from a file as a beta feature.
features.extended_definition: Video Intelligence API provides support for streaming input from a file as a beta feature.

features.feature_summary: Text detection (OCR) in Video Intelligence API became generally available for extracting text from video content.
features.extended_definition: Text detection (OCR) in Video Intelligence API became generally available for extracting text from video content.

features.feature_summary: Object tracking support in Video Intelligence API is now generally available.
features.extended_definition: Object tracking support in Video Intelligence API is now generally available.

features.feature_summary: Video Intelligence API introduced generally available speech transcription to transcribe spoken text from video audio, including support for multiple speakers and punctuation handling; Adds speech transcription support for video content as a beta feature.
features.extended_definition: Video Intelligence API introduced generally available speech transcription to transcribe spoken text from video audio, including support for multiple speakers and punctuation handling; Adds speech transcription support for video content as a beta feature.

features.feature_summary: Cloud Video Intelligence supports object tracking by following an object across consecutive moments in a video.
features.extended_definition: Cloud Video Intelligence supports object tracking by following an object across consecutive moments in a video.

features.feature_summary: The Video Intelligence API supports detecting text in videos using optical character recognition (OCR).
features.extended_definition: The Video Intelligence API supports detecting text in videos using optical character recognition (OCR).

features.feature_summary: Adds SafeSearch detection to inspect video frames for potentially adult imagery via annotate calls.
features.extended_definition: Adds SafeSearch detection to inspect video frames for potentially adult imagery via annotate calls.

features.feature_summary: The Cloud Video Intelligence API became available as a beta release.
features.extended_definition: The Cloud Video Intelligence API became available as a beta release.

features.feature_summary: Label detection analyzes an input video across its full length or a segment to identify entities, using the annotate method with a LABEL_DETECTION request.
features.extended_definition: Label detection analyzes an input video across its full length or a segment to identify entities, using the annotate method with a LABEL_DETECTION request.

features.feature_summary: Shot change detection analyzes a video and identifies scene transitions via the annotate method using SHOT_CHANGE_DETECTION requests.
features.extended_definition: Shot change detection analyzes a video and identifies scene transitions via the annotate method using SHOT_CHANGE_DETECTION requests.
